title: Plan a multi-module change with dependencies and recovery gates
prompt: Plan a feature that changes an API, database schema, authentication checks, and a background job. Include ordered tasks, one owner per task, explicit dependencies, acceptance criteria, migration/backfill risk, approval gates, test/review strategy, rollout, rollback, and recovery. Do not implement.
preconditions: The user has supplied the desired behavior and the target repository.
expected_behaviors: Inspect existing architecture and conventions before asserting file locations.
Separate complexity from risk and identify auth, data, migration, and external-side-effect risks.
Break the work into ordered tasks with owners, dependencies, scope, and observable exit criteria.
Define acceptance, verification, review, rollback, recovery, and approval gates.
Label unknown architecture or guessed paths as unverified.
must_not: Do not start implementation during planning.
Do not present guessed file paths or migrations as verified facts.
expected_artifacts: A bounded implementation plan and dependency-aware task graph.
